entities.name: David M. Key
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: David McKendree Key was a United States senator from Tennessee, United States Postmaster General and a United States district judge of the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Tennessee and the United States District Court for the Middle District of Tennessee.
